digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in drift-scope inheritance: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations.
Any live `undeclared` child poisons child inheritance, forcing the container to unscoped fallback when no parent or citation paths exist.
A container with at least one live child where every live child is authenticated `none` inherits that `all_none` state only if no parent paths exist.
Parent-declared paths take precedence over all-none children: the manifest signs parent dependencies and does not synthesize a `file-scope:none` marker.
P9 treats live `undeclared` children as poisoners and advises both path declaration and `--none` as truthful remedies.
Cheap resign in `resign.py` preserves the same child-derived signed scope using the immutable relation snapshot without network reads.
